conf.description: Cisco NX-OS interface-vpc-state / snmp-trap: reparse of clogHistMsgText for the LINK/LINEPROTO UPDOWN and ETHPORT up/down(+reason) shapes per direct.elastic, plus a full mnemonic-to-event.action lookup covering the vPC and L2FM_MAC_MOVE2 families (no verbatim body grammar was given for those, so only mnemonic-level action is derived -- see README gap for the vPC domain number and MAC-move address/interface pair).

conf.comment: cisco-nxos / interface-vpc-state / snmp-trap. Trap receiver forwards varbinds as JSON. Dissects '(Line protocol on )Interface X, changed state to up|down' (LINK/LINEPROTO, disambiguated by clogHistFacility since both share the UPDOWN mnemonic) and 'Interface X is up|down (reason)' (ETHPORT, recovering the reason into event.reason). vPC (PEER_LINK_DOWN etc.) and L2FM_MAC_MOVE2 get event.action from clogHistMsgName alone -- the work order gives no sample body grammar for the vPC domain number or the MAC-move address/interface pair, so those are not extracted.

functions.description: document the UPDOWN/ETHPORT dissect and the vPC/L2FM mnemonic-only scope limit
extract the JSON-encoded varbind object the upstream SNMP trap receiver forwards
map the straight 1:1 CISCO-SYSLOG-MIB varbinds onto their targets (event.original is reparsed further below)
dissect the LINK/LINEPROTO UPDOWN interface/line-protocol state-change shape
dissect the ETHPORT up/down shape and recover the parenthesised down reason

add.name: event.action
add.value: event.code === 'UPDOWN' ? (cisco_nexus.log.facility === 'LINK' ? (__e['upd_state'] === 'up' ? 'link_up' : __e['upd_state'] === 'down' ? 'link_down' : undefined) : cisco_nexus.log.facility === 'LINEPROTO' ? (__e['upd_state'] === 'up' ? 'line_protocol_up' : __e['upd_state'] === 'down' ? 'line_protocol_down' : undefined) : undefined) : event.code === 'IF_UP' ? 'interface_up' : event.code === 'IF_ADMIN_UP' ? 'interface_admin_up' : event.code === 'IF_DOWN_LINK_FAILURE' ? 'interface_down_link_failure' : event.code === 'IF_DOWN_ADMIN_DOWN' ? 'interface_admin_down' : event.code === 'IF_DOWN_INITIALIZING' ? 'interface_down_initializing' : event.code === 'SPEED' ? 'interface_speed_change' : event.code === 'IF_DUPLEX' ? 'interface_duplex_change' : event.code === 'PEER_KEEP_ALIVE_RECV_FAIL' ? 'vpc_peer_keepalive_failed' : event.code === 'PEER_LINK_DOWN' ? 'vpc_peer_link_down' : event.code === 'PEER_KEEP_ALIVE_RECV_SUCCESS' ? 'vpc_peer_keepalive_recovered' : event.code === 'L2FM_MAC_MOVE2' ? 'mac_move_detected' : undefined

functions.description: map interface name and down-reason, derive event.action from the branch match or (vPC/L2FM/admin cases) from a full clogHistMsgName lookup, recover inverted severity, drop temps
tag the event with its dataset
